description: This file defines a Migration class for handling database migration tasks in vtiger CRM, including taking database dumps, dropping and creating databases, applying dumps, and modifying databases for version upgrades.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods for database migration, including dump, drop, create, apply, and modify operations, as well as migration orchestration.

methods.name: Migration
methods.description: Constructor initializing old and new database connections.

methods.name: setOldDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the old database.

methods.name: setNewDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the new database.

methods.name: takeDatabaseDump
methods.description: Creates a dump of the specified database and returns the filename.

methods.name: applyDumpData
methods.description: Applies a dump file to a specified database.

methods.name: localGetTabID
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: getTablesCountInNewDatabase
methods.description: Returns the number of tables in the new database.

methods.name: getTablesCountInOldDatabase
methods.description: Returns the number of tables in the old database.

methods.name: modifyDatabase
methods.description: Modifies the database schema to match a newer version.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Coordinates the entire migration process based on user options and database states.
